parks.note: Refuge headquarters. Interpretive trail through salt marsh, shrubland and meadow. Open daily, half hour before sunrise to half hour after sunset.
Barrier beach; one of the best birdwatching spots in Connecticut. Observation deck at the entrance. Piping plover and least tern nesting habitat.
Nature trail, sandy beach and the 1868 Sheffield Island lighthouse. Reached by seasonal Norwalk Seaport Association ferry or private boat.
